# Meaningful Sound

> Meaningful Sound is an independent studio building native iOS, iPadOS, and macOS apps for working musicians. Best known for PedalEditor — the premier iPhone Bluetooth and Wi-Fi MIDI controller and editor for guitar pedals and synths.

## Apps

- [PedalEditor](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/): The premier iPhone Bluetooth and Wi-Fi MIDI controller, editor, and librarian for guitar pedals and synthesizers. Supports 47+ instruments across 13 brands including Strymon, Chase Bliss, Walrus Audio, Meris, Eventide, Boss, UAFX, plus classic synths (Yamaha DX7, Roland JV-1080, Alesis QS6). Brilliant library organization system: Rig → Project → Pedal → Bank → Preset. Song-by-song setlist scenes recall whole-board presets in one tap. iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No accounts, no analytics. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pedaleditor/id6761016084).
- [Fretboard Origin](https://meaningfulsound.net/FretboardOrigin/): A fretboard companion for every stringed instrument you play — 34 instruments (guitar, bass, mandolin, banjo, ukulele, oud, sitar, koto, charango, dotara, and more), 288 chord voicings, scales and modes, built-in chromatic tuner, and a tanpura drone for practice. Native iPhone, iPad, and Mac. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fretboard-origin/id6764200037).
- [SongForm](https://meaningfulsound.net/SongForm/): A songwriter's workspace for sections, lyrics, layers, and co-writes. Multi-take recording, key/scale theory, fragment-based collaboration, portable `.songform` document. Native iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Coming soon.

## Key Facts

- **Developer:** Meaningful Sound (independent studio)
- **Platforms:** iOS, iPadOS, macOS — all native, no Electron, no web wrappers
- **Privacy posture:** No accounts. No analytics. No advertising. No third-party SDKs. iCloud sync uses the user's personal account; Meaningful Sound has no access to user content.
- **Distribution:** Apple App Store only
- **Contact:** Instagram [@pedaleditor](https://instagram.com/pedaleditor)

## PedalEditor Detail

- [PedalEditor landing page](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/): Full feature inventory, supported pedals and synths, comparison vs single-brand editors (Nixie, Walrus app, Chase Bliss app, Meris app), platforms, FAQ.
- [PedalEditor privacy policy](https://meaningfulsound.net/PedalEditor/privacy/): Privacy policy covering all Meaningful Sound apps.
- [Full content for AI ingestion](https://meaningfulsound.net/llms-full.txt): Complete markdown content of the marketing pages.

## Supported Pedals & Synths (PedalEditor, 47 at launch)

- **Strymon (12):** BigSky, Cloudburst, Compadre, Deco v2, DIG v2, Flint v2, Iridium, NightSky, Riverside, Sunset, Timeline, Volante
- **Chase Bliss (7):** Blooper, Brothers, Generation Loss MkII, Habit, Lossy, Mood MkII, Warped Vinyl MkII
- **Walrus Audio (5):** ACS1 MkI, ACS1 MkII, Mako D1, Mako M1, Mako R1
- **Meris (4):** Enzo, Hedra, LVX, Mercury7
- **Boss (4):** DD-200, EQ-200, IR-200, RE-202
- **UAFX (3):** Dream '65, Lion '68, Ruby '63
- **Source Audio (3):** Atlas, C4 Synth, Ultrawave
- **Red Panda (2):** Particle V2, Tensor
- **Eventide (2):** Space, TimeFactor
- **Hologram (1):** Microcosm
- **Old Blood Noise (1):** Dark Star
- **Vintage Synths (3):** Yamaha DX7, Roland JV-1080, Alesis QS6
- **Plus:** Profile Builder Wizard for unsupported hardware
